# DramaCool

> > DramaCool is a streaming platform for Asian dramas with English subtitles, featuring Chinese, Korean, and Thai series from 2023-2024.

The site provides free streaming access to popular Asian drama episodes including In Blossom, The Last Cook, Strange Tales of Jiang Cheng, You Are My Secret, and many others. Episodes are available with English subtitles for international audiences.
